This section collects longer-form essays and technical notes — not a personal or news blog — on complex systems, network science, agent-based modeling, computational economics, and public policy. Posts may include equations, code, data visualizations, and references, and are cited in [`references/references.bib`](references/references.bib) where relevant.

The entries below are currently **planned placeholders**, marked as such, rather than published essays.
